title: APS 2025 Annual Progress Report for Planning Coordination
publisher: Arizona Public Service Company (to WECC Studies Subcommittee)
summary: APS's 2025 report to WECC (2025-2034): waiver requests for Goodyear 230kV, Snowflake Solar TPIF, Q264 TPIF, Cholla-Chevelon cut-in to Sitgreaves, Saguaro Power Campus Upgrades, North Gila-Orchard 230kV #2, Agua Fria-Contrail 230kV, plus 23 previously waived projects with 2025-plan dates. Superseded by the 2026 plan and APR; useful mainly for matching 2025-vintage WECC cases.

findings.statement: Lists Three Rivers 230kV, Serrano gen-tie and Rabbit Canyon 500kV switchyard and lines as placed in service in 2024; dates for TS22 (2028), Jojoba-Rudd (2032), TS21 cut-in and TS21-Broadway (2032) and the 345kV rebuilds (2037) were later changed in the 2026 APR.
